offering_description.value: Rents and sells natural gas compression equipment and vapor recovery units to oil and gas producers and midstream gas operators across major US production basins. It also provides installation, maintenance and aftermarket parts for its equipment.

primary_products.value: natural gas compressor units; vapor recovery units; compressor parts and components

primary_services.value: compressor rental; installation and startup; maintenance and repair

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production companies, midstream gas gathering and processing operators

end_markets.value: oil and gas production; midstream gas gathering and processing

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: compressor units rented to producers and midstream operators; product sales: compressor and vapor recovery unit sales; service fees: installation, maintenance, repair and aftermarket parts
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: fabricates and assembles compressor packages in its own shops, sold or rented to gas producers; asset operator: owns and operates a rental fleet of compressors at customer well sites and plants; service provider: maintains and services compression equipment, taking in equipment and fees from operators
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; asset operator; service provider

geography_served.value: US national: major US oil and gas basins, including Texas, Oklahoma, the Rockies and Appalachia

specialization.value: niche specialist: natural gas compression rental, sales and aftermarket services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with producers and midstream operators; own locations: company service and fabrication facilities in key producing regions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: air emission and workplace safety rules for field equipment, such as EPA and state air permits and OSHA
